subject: Post-demo playbook & confirmation of evaluation leads / schedule
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finovo.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@finovo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo playbook & confirmation of evaluation leads / schedule

Hi Elena & Samir,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the practical questions on latency and data handling. I promised to pull together a lightweight playbook so your team has a clear evaluation path and owners. Please find the attached: Finovo-evaluation-playbook-v1.2.pdf and a compact evaluation-checklist.xlsx.

Recap (short):
- Goal: 2-week validation to measure latency/cost and integration surface for ingest pipeline.
- Proposed start window: week of Jun 13 (we can shift earlier/later if you prefer).
- Redwood side: Rafael (sales/PM support), Marissa (solutions + onboarding), Monica (security & deployment).

Ask: could you confirm two things by EOD next Wed (Jun 2)?
1) Who will lead the evaluation on Finovo's side (technical lead and product champion) — name/email for calendar invites.
2) Whether the proposed week of Jun 13 works, or share alternative preferred windows.

Next steps I can take once I have those:
- Lock a 60-minute kickoff with a short agenda (technical checklist + acceptance criteria).
- Share calendar hold + access to the shared Drive folder.
- Provision a scoped test tenant with sample data guidance (if needed).

Attachments:
- Finovo-evaluation-playbook-v1.2.pdf (playbook + MTP)
- evaluation-checklist.xlsx (track pass/fail criteria + contacts)

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FIN-2027-089) and Drive folder included in the attachments list above.

If you want, I can also send a one-page mutual timeline (2 columns: Finovo tasks / Redwood support) — just tell me who on your end should be listed.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0142

--
Attachments: Finovo-evaluation-playbook-v1.2.pdf (application/pdf), evaluation-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Subject: RE: Post-demo playbook & confirmation of evaluation leads / schedule

Hi Elena — quick bump on this.

I wanted to check whether you had a chance to review the playbook and whether the week of Jun 13 still looks reasonable. We can shift to the following week if that helps with schedules.

If it helps, I can propose two specific kickoff slots (Tuesday/Wednesday morning) and send calendar invites once you confirm owners.

Thanks — Rafael

Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: quick touch: locking owners for the playbook

Hi Elena — small nudge from our side. Rafael and I want to make sure we assign the right people on both sides so the kickoff is productive. If you already have names, feel free to reply with them and we’ll send invites.

If your team needs more time to assign leads, let us know a preferred window and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Soto <elena@finovo.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@finovo.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo playbook & confirmation of evaluation leads / schedule

Thanks Rafael — and thanks Marissa for the nudge. Apologies for the delay; we were sorting internal calendars.

Confirmation from our side:
- Product champion: Elena Soto (me) — elena@finovo.com
- Technical lead: Samir Gupta — samir.g@finovo.com

The proposed week of Jun 13 works for us. Can we lock Tue Jun 15 10:00–11:00 PT for the kickoff? Samir and I will both attend.

We received the Finovo-evaluation-playbook-v1.2.pdf and the checklist — the playbook looks good. A couple of small asks before kickoff:
- Can you add a one-line entry in the playbook under "Success criteria" that ties back to the latency SLO we discussed (p95 < 300ms for the sample dataset)?
- Share the test tenant instructions in the Drive folder so Samir can get credentials ahead of time.

If you confirm the kickoff time, I’ll accept the invite and we’ll share our internal attendee list.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Product | Finovo
elena@finovo.com
